acceptanceCriteria: 50 consecutive passes of TestPSRRequestConflictAndOrphan under -count on darwin.
The timing dependency behind 'new explicit request never executed' is named, and the test waits on an observed event rather than a deadline.
body:
Suspected flake, reported 2026-10-05 by the pstack-claude agent optimization session; pre-existing on origin/main, seen once in a full `make gate` run on the batch head. Failure: pool_sweep_lifecycle_test.go:635 'new explicit request never executed'.

Repro: `TMPDIR=/private/tmp/claude-501/td GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=8 -timeout 30m -run 'TestPSRRequestConflictAndOrphan' ./internal/tasks/store/` — 2/8 failures on origin/main ee925a4b, 0/8 on c0a8b4ba, 0/8 on batch 2c36814d (Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1).

Related: V1-0724 (PSR store tests sensitive to host load, general) — this ticket names one subtest with a count-based repro; close it into V1-0724 if the same timing dependency is the cause. V1-0753 (symlinked TMPDIR) is distinct. Evidence 2026-10-05: (1) pstack session at bc87a4dc (claude/v1-0325-intent-worktree + origin/main ee925a4b), TMPDIR=/private/tmp/claude-501/td, go test ./internal/tasks/... ./cmd/corvint-tasks/...: live-unknown-gone failed at pool_sweep_lifecycle_test.go:539 'strconv.Atoi: parsing "": invalid syntax', all other packages passed. (2) orchestrator batch trees 9708c91c and 2d39568b (claude/batch-2026-10-05), TMPDIR=/private/tmp/claude-501/v7t: same line-539 failure in the full store run, and -count=3 -run TestPSRRequestConflictAndOrphan failed again on both (2d39568b also failed request-and-policy-fences) while another session ran PSR loops on the host. Inferred, unconfirmed hypothesis: psrAwaitMarker returns once the marker file exists but the reset child creates it before writing its PID (non-atomic create-then-write), so the test reads an empty file; the earlier line-635 'new explicit request never executed' symptom may share the timing window. Fix direction: write the marker atomically (temp file plus rename) or await non-empty parseable content.
title: tests (suspected flake): tasks/store TestPSRRequestConflictAndOrphan/live-unknown-gone fails 'new explicit request never executed'
